Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study focuses on characterizing a cellular hierarchy within a disease model (AML). While 'differentiation stage' is the primary axis of comparison, it is a cell-state variable and thus mapped to the unclassified/cell-state category as per the ontology rules. The 'treatment' in this context is the disease state itself. The mention of TFE vs water is a technical method comparison, not a biological perturbation.
